D3BPLAN-R3-NBO-1.disposition: Carried as a code-unit rule: the arming Instant is sampled only after a successful observe_clock read has completed, including its monotonic_after sample, and the determination Instant is sampled at the decision point after any failed read. The lower bound is stated relative to the fixed monotonic_before reference bracket (LD-D3B-10). D3b-2 adds a deterministic delayed-arming-read control proving the read interval is not counted twice. No clock reset, field or successor.

X-D3B-1.defect: D3a-3 (integrated at 2fbb779) has RecordFact::CancelSent with no inband field, and supplies() documents inband as always true for D3a's T-1 cancel (supervisor_records.rs:175-176). That contradicts M3-L r7:910 and the r1 Q5 ruling: a fault ladder's T-1 sends no in-band Cancel (ML 16b).
X-D3B-1.fix: D3b-2 adds inband: bool to the fact; D3a's T-1 sets it false; stage 1 sets it true exactly when the in-band Cancel was written before the control cancel. Mutations and write-completion controls pin both true and false cases. Codex r2 agreed the correction is right and belongs in D3b-2.

leadDecisions: Linux (item 18 sweep) is D3b-L after D1a-L on a Linux lane
D3b-1 and D3b-2 start only after D3a-4 and D2b-3b r2 integrate (both touch supervisor.rs); D3b-0 may start now
rootAssessment: Lead assent to the D3b plan r3 (M3-D r5 items 18, 19 and 23): D3b-0 the bounded macOS descendant mechanisms in process.rs with the protected-root kill on the owned child; D3b-1 item 18's snapshot, group kill, identity-checked kill, confirm and reap with a truthful tree report and TreeEvidence; D3b-2 item 19's two-stage user cancellation under one stamped gate order, the fault ladder for revocation and observer fail-stop with item 14's 5 s ceiling, and S6's marks tracked to a terminal state with a fail-closed clock policy. Three ordinary event registrations and two literal tables. Rounds 1 and 2 left four and one findings, each answered in the next round; round 3 one observation, carried.
